svg.title: Application & AWS topology
svg.desc: The runtime: CloudFront + WAF (WCM-only) → NetScaler → ALB :443 → ECS Fargate → Aurora + OpenSearch, with /_next/static and a shared ISR cache on S3 and Claude via Bedrock. Also shown: the staff write-path (SAML + LDAP authz, append-only audit) and the off-request-path ETL plane (Step Functions → per-secret Fargate task families). Box fill encodes resource type; the top accent stripe names the owning CDK stack. A separate nightly plane rolls CloudFront access logs into a durable, aggregates-only usage table that /edit/usage reads.

g.title: Internet — WCM-network visitors; others → branded block page
CloudFront + AWS WAF — WCM-only IP allowlist · rate-limit 429; managed + Bot Control (count)
S3 · static + ISR cache — /_next/static/* · OAC (EdgeStack); next-isr-cache/ · 7-day (AppStack)
WCM NetScaler — HTTPS origin front
Secrets Manager — env injected at task start
WCM SAML IdP — login-proxy
WCM ED + Cornell LDAP — LDAPS · authz · directory members
Amazon Bedrock — Claude Opus 4.8 + Sonnet 4.x; IAM-scoped, no Haiku
ReCiter DynamoDB — Analysis · GoldStandard read; core-claim + submission write
Public ALB · sps-public — HTTPS :443 · X-Origin-Verify; else default 403
ECS Fargate · sps-app — Next.js (Node 22) + OTel sidecar
Internal ALB — POST /api/revalidate
Aurora MySQL — Serverless v2 · writer+reader; scholars + scholars_audit
OpenSearch 2.19 — 5 aliases: people · pubs; funding · opportunities · trials
scholars_audit DB — append-only B03 audit; same Aurora cluster
Deploy one-shot tasks — db-bootstrap → migrate →; verify-grants · search canary
ECS Fargate · sps-etl — sps-etl + per-secret task families:; sources · ldap · reciter-api · ctsc; bulk-data-rule (Python)
EventBridge — crons + 5-min reconcilers
Step Functions — nightly · weekly · annual; heartbeat · honors · grants-export; reconcile + cdn-reconcile (5 min); staging only: backup · ED bridge
S3 · ETL buckets — SES inbound mail (clips · funding); grants export · curation backup
DR backup vault — us-west-2 · cross-region
Observability — alarms → 3 SNS topics → relay λ → Teams; edge-origin probe λ (5 min) · relay DLQ; reliability dashboard · cost guards (prod); OTLP traces → X-Ray + New Relic
